title: Design, synthesis and anti-tumor activation of beta-carboline alkaloids derivatives from Picrasma quassioides.
authors: Sun, Yupei; Yi, Yanhui; Wang, Bingkang; Li, Jinrong; Zhao, Feng; Xin, Jianzeng; Liu, Sheng
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计合成β-咔啉衍生物并评估抗肿瘤活性，分子对接仅针对p65/ERK蛋白，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: In this study, a series of N-9 substituted beta-carboline derivatives were designed, synthesized, and further evaluated for their anti-tumor activity through an integrated approach combining network pharmacology, chemical synthesis, in vitro pharmacological assays, and molecular docking. Furthermore, the underlying mechanism of action was elucidated. Firstly, 33 kinds of beta-carboline alkaloids in Picrasma quassioides were screened by TCMSP, HERB and other databases. 493 potential anti-tumor targets were obtained by target prediction and intersection analysis. Combined with GO and KEGG enrichment analysis, MAPK and NF-kappaB signaling pathways were determined as the core research directions. Ten beta-carboline N-9 substituted derivatives were successfully synthesized from L-tryptophan by Pictet-Spengler reaction, oxidative cyclization and amide condensation reaction. The yields were 55.29%  approximately  77.39%. The results showed that compound 4 had significant anticancer activity in vitro, and its mechanism was related to the targeted regulation of MAPK and NF-kappaB signaling pathways. It can block the activation of NF-kappaB and ERK 1/2 signaling pathways by down-regulating the expression of p-p65 and p-ERK 1/2 proteins. Molecular docking results showed that compound 4 could form a stable binding conformation with p65, ERK 1 and ERK 2 target proteins through intermolecular forces such as van der Waals force and hydrogen bond, among which the binding affinity with ERK 1 was the strongest. This finding provides experimental basis and theoretical support for the development of targeted anticancer drugs derived from natural products.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过整合网络药理学、化学合成、体外药理学实验及分子对接的方法，设计、合成了一系列N-9取代的β-咔啉衍生物，并进一步评估了其抗肿瘤活性，同时阐明了其潜在的作用机制。首先，通过TCMSP、HERB等数据库筛选了苦木中33种β-咔啉生物碱，经靶点预测和交集分析获得493个潜在抗肿瘤靶点。结合GO和KEGG富集分析，确定MAPK和NF-kappaB信号通路为核心研究方向。以L-色氨酸为原料，通过Pictet-Spengler反应、氧化环化及酰胺缩合反应成功合成了10种β-咔啉N-9取代衍生物，产率为55.29%至77.39%。结果表明，化合物4在体外具有显著的抗癌活性，其机制与靶向调控MAPK和NF-kappaB信号通路相关，可通过下调p-p65和p-ERK 1/2蛋白的表达来阻断NF-kappaB和ERK 1/2信号通路的激活。分子对接结果显示，化合物4能通过范德华力和氢键等分子间作用力与p65、ERK 1和ERK 2靶蛋白形成稳定的结合构象，其中与ERK 1的结合亲和力最强。这一发现为开发源自天然产物的靶向抗癌药物提供了实验依据和理论支持。
